A Wick-tender watches a man suffocate in a pressure lock because his balance ran out. The bell is rung. The Director announces the Throat will close in fifty-two days, and the indentured will stay.
Three centuries on, a cutter in the frozen Cold Wards finds a Company hatch. At home her mother coughs; the neighbours strike an empty bell hook for their dead. The Count proclaims the Calling.
At Port Ambry, where the Throat is healing, a bonded lien adjuster takes the job of collecting a seven-hundred-year-old debt. An archivist comes aboard with a bell covered in names.
The Speakers put their demand to the Director and are refused. The comptroller who built the Tally tells Dagny there is a master key, and that it takes two.
A junior counter audits the Hask family for the Calling, finds the arithmetic wrong, and pulls the root of the Caul Account. Nobody holds it.
The race through the healing Throat. A rival ship dies in its lips. On the far side, the Sabra system is silent on every band.
The Wick crews dim the lamp. Security storms the spine and a man dies. Teodor brings Dagny the shape of the keys, and Odile asks for more bell.
Tamsin sells her hatch to the smugglers of the Salt and cuts it open. Inside: empty fuel racks, a manifest pointing to C-V, and names scratched in the dark.
The Good Title finds the Company's dead throat-watch station. Haste explains what a lien attaches to. Something in the system is still counting.
Teodor confesses Caul Deep. Kas flies Dagny to the sealed shaft. The Throat was never closing: the Company is closing it.
Orrin decodes C-V. There is fuel, and the Count is keeping it. The first of the Called go into the cold.
Fen breaks the throat-watch logs and finds nine hundred people who never arrived anywhere. Corvin opens the hold.
Varga tells Dagny the Concord will not save them. Pim is dimmed. Odile engraves the dead of Caul. Dagny makes a new plan, and tells her brother.
The last keeper of the lamp says it can be relit. Agathe's name goes on the list. The Salt names its price.
The bailiffs drill for consolidation. A sleeper dies in her pod. Haste seizes the bell as an asset of the Sabra Concern.
The boarding of the Covenant is betrayed. Kas has sold the plan for two seats out.
Orrin is struck from the books. Tamsin walks her mother into the Cold Wards.
Haste takes the ship. The captain dies. Corvin signs. On the bell's crown, words in another hand.
At the mouth of the Throat, Dagny learns what Teodor's key really does, and chooses who Lantern will owe.
The Called climb out of the cold and into the Hulk. Its name is still on its bridge.
Lantern comes out of eclipse. Nine hundred names, and a bell to ring for each.
